exec: const secret = pm.variables.get('jwtSecret');
function b64url(wa){ return CryptoJS.enc.Base64.stringify(wa).replace(/=+$/,'').replace(/\+/g,'-').replace(/\//g,'_'); }
const enc = (s) => b64url(CryptoJS.enc.Utf8.parse(s));
const now = Math.floor(Date.now()/1000);
const h = enc(JSON.stringify({alg:'HS256',typ:'JWT'}));
const p = enc(JSON.stringify({role:'customer',sub:'c1',iat:now,exp:now+3600}));
const sig = b64url(CryptoJS.HmacSHA256(h + '.' + p, secret));
pm.variables.set('customerToken', h + '.' + p + '.' + sig);
